notes:
Passed on the fake backend (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level); simulated R0 and no hardware was attached. Model-authored and unreviewed. The fake is a kinematic pure-Python stand-in for REALRobotEnv: joint commands are integrated with the upstream per-step clamp (env.py:314-321), but there are no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, object physics or rendered camera. NOT COVERED: the full 240x320x3 retina/goal and 240x320 depth/mask arrays; the fake returns 24x32 test-data arrays of the declared type and rank (the real sizes are robot.py:30-31,86-95, named in the fidelity gaps). The fake was not compared with the upstream PyBullet environment, and the gym.make(env_id) path (gym, pybullet, real_robots) was not run. Warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 is the expected seed bookkeeping (the bridge stores the seed and the fake's reset consumes it); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for observation_space is because REALRobotEnv inherits that attribute from Kuka/MJCFBaseBulletEnv outside the class AST in the clone; the five G8.NO_UNIT warnings are the bridge-derived inputs (ticks, seed twice, action.joint_command in radians, action.render 0/1) whose catalogue class states no unit. The action limits are the environment's own Box bounds (robot.py:58-71), no Limit is declared by the driver, there is no operator-required bound, no catalogue extension and no site-limits overlay.
